function: Jointly learns UAV trajectory, transmit power, power allocation, SCMA mapping matrix and STAR-RIS phase shifts to maximize energy efficiency (p. 1).
system: Downlink, single-antenna UAV base station, 6 single-antenna users, 4 resource elements; STAR-RIS (simultaneously transmitting and reflecting, mode switching, 100 passive elements); 2.4 GHz (pp. 2, 4).
method: Reinforcement learning: PPO on-policy actor and critic DNNs (512, 256, 256, 256 units, SiLU, Adamax), trained on simulated downlink cycles (pp. 3, 4).
data_channel: Custom simulation only: path loss (exponents from [13]), random scattering CN(0,1) UAV-user, free-space UAV-RIS, Rician RIS-user; no 3GPP model, dataset or measurements (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Single simulated scenario (1000 m area, J=6, K=4, N=100); Fig. 3 sweeps N=16 to 100; no train/test mismatch stated (pp. 4, 5).
baselines: Counterparts of the proposed framework: PD-NOMA, conventional RIS, zero STAR-RIS phases, uniform power allocation, fixed mapping matrix; no earlier published method compared (pp. 4, 5).
metrics: Average reward and energy efficiency (bits/Hz/Joule) versus DL cycles, learning rate, and number of STAR-RIS elements (p. 5).
complexity: Order of training cost per iteration, T(Opi + C) + E*BS(Opi*OV), in terms of actor and critic complexities; no FLOPs, parameters or runtime (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "follows the Rician fading model" - STAR-RIS to user link; UAV-user is random scattering CN(0,1) and UAV-RIS free space, all from the authors' own simulator after [13]. No 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured channel is named.
q2_support: p. 4: "In the simulation, we set J = 6, K = 4, dv = 2, df = 3" - one scenario; Fig. 3 (p. 5) sweeps N, but no model trained under other conditions is tested, and no fine-tuning, transfer or meta-learning is reported.
q3_support: p. 5: "which serve as baseline counterparts to SCMA" - PD-NOMA and RIS counterparts, plus the ablations of p. 4, all of the same PPO framework; no earlier learned method or other learning algorithm (DQN, DDPG, etc.) is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "Its complexity for each training iteration is given by" a formula in T, E, BS and the actor and critic complexities; symbolic, and it covers training only.
q5_support: p. 4: "are summarized in Table III" - simulation parameters only. No code or data link or DOI, no public channel dataset, no measured data; channels come from the authors' own simulator.
notes: Include: PPO jointly learns UAV trajectory (above the physical layer) with transmit power, power allocation, SCMA mapping and STAR-RIS phases (physical layer), so above_phy passes by the joint-decision rule; a RIS is present, so the system check passes. Area: RIS phases fit area 3, and learned power and resource control of an aerial link fits area 6; 6 wins in the order 7, 4, 6, 5, then 1-3. q4 counts the symbolic training-complexity formula on p. 4 (no numbers, training only); the reviewer may want to check it. PD-NOMA and RIS counterparts appear to use the same agent (p. 5: 'offer the agent greater flexibility'), so none is an earlier learned method.
